description:
Link two related service requests in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. You will find two open requests regarding VPN connectivity issues in Building A. 

1. Log in as 'administrator' (password: 'administrator').
2. Identify the two requests: 'VPN connection drops intermittently...' and 'Unable to establish VPN tunnel...'.
3. Open one of the requests and use the 'Relations' or 'Link Requests' feature to link it to the other request.
4. Set the relationship type to 'Related' (or equivalent) if prompted.

Ensure the link is saved and visible in the Relations tab.

metadata.request_a_subject: VPN connection drops intermittently for Building A users
metadata.request_b_subject: Unable to establish VPN tunnel from Building A conference rooms
